worldcombat.skill.terrainpulse.summary: Press the ground into a travelling pulse that follows native step heights and stops at missing ground or tall walls. Grounded terrain determines its launch element and bonus; resonance makes adjacent narrow and wide waves.
worldcombat.skill.terrainpulse.use.1: Amplify power while standing on terrain
worldcombat.skill.terrainpulse.descripti: Each wave has about %1$s special power and hits each enemy once. Terrain type and power apply only when the caster is grounded in that terrain at launch.
After %1$s seconds, advance along supported ground for up to %2$s blocks. Connected steps up to one block are traversable; missing support or blocking structures stop the wave.
Resonance sends one narrow and one wide wave in the same direction, each dealing 0.7 times the usual damage. A ring lights up at each impact.
worldcombat.skill.terrainpulse.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.terrainpulse.preferenc: On: a second ground ring follows the first, each wave at x0.7, good for covering a patch; Off: a single wave at full power, good against one target. Both directions trade area for damage.
Only send the wave within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to send the wave; when off it stays put.
